gemini.performance_metric: no separately disclosed 3-5-year financial trajectory exists
gemini.rationale: The provided slice indicates that the surviving corporation reports on a consolidated, single-segment basis, offering no specific financial or operational breakout for the acquired business. There is no documented evidence of disruption at the product/process interface or fracture at the process/organization interface; conversely, key executives from the acquired entity remained in senior leadership roles three years post-merger.

grok.performance_metric: no separate 3-5yr financials; executives and footprint retained
grok.rationale: The slice documents no product/process interface disruption (p4=0): the surviving corporation’s FY2020 10-K still reports a branch network spanning the same four states as the acquired franchise, with results managed on a single consolidated segment and no disclosed product-line or operations incoherence. Likewise no process/organization fracture is documented (p5=0): three named continuing officers of the acquired company (CEO Brown, CFO Anderson, GC/CRO Woods) are listed as executive officers of the survivor roughly three years post-close, with the pre-merger survivor CEO as Chairman. Absence of any realized-disruption evidence yields 0 on both pathways.

openai.performance_metric: 3 named acquired-company officers remained senior executives roughly 3 years after closing
openai.rationale: The surviving corporation reported all operations in one consolidated segment and provided no acquired-business breakout or documented product-line/operations disruption, so no p4 pathway is documented. Roughly three years after closing, the acquired company’s chief executive, chief financial officer, and general counsel continued in senior executive roles at the surviving corporation; the slice documents no operations-versus-organization fracture, so p5 is coded 0.
